title: Pigly's Combat Tweaks
description: Combat-related tweaks that can be enabled through config options. Mace cooldown, better impaling, anti combat log, etc.
body:
# Pigly's Combat Tweaks

This plugin includes many combat-related tweaks that SMP servers may want to use. All tweaks are disabled by default.
## Cooldowns
    cooldowns:
        mace: 0
Set cooldowns for certain items, only supports mace currently.

## Trident Tweaks
    tridentTweaks:
        betterImpaling: false
This section contains tweaks to make tridents more useful in combat.
Better impaling makes impaling do extra damage against mobs in rain and water, like how it works on mobile and console.

## Combat Tracker
    combatTracker:
        enabled: false
        time: 30 #time in seconds combat lasts for
        antiCombatLog: true #players will be killed when combat logging
        disableInCombat:
            fireworks: false
            enderPearls: false
            windCharge: false
The plugin can kill players who combat log and disable use of certain items during combat.
Players are notified when entering and leaving combat.
You can set the time after being hit last when the player will leave combat.
